root_text:
Stay Safe from HMPV!

Symptoms: Cough, fever, shortness of breath, wheezing.

Precautions: Wash hands, avoid sick people, disinfect surfaces, stay home if unwell.

Seek medical help if symptoms worsen.
#StayHealthy #HMPV #SCIInternationalHo
